name: Single piece peg-top! easy to print and customizable!

captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a geometric spinning top designed for easy 3D printing. It features a wide, flat, polygonal base with beveled edges and corners, forming a low-profile pyramid shape on one side. A central, tapered spindle pole with a rounded spherical tip extends from the flat face to serve as the handle for spinning.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric spinning top in OpenSCAD based on a polygonal pyramid. The user should be able to customize the overall diameter, the number of sides of the polygon, the bevel percentages for the corners and edges, and the length and thickness of the central spindle handle.
captions.factory: The spinning top is constructed using a union of two main parts: the polygonal body and the spindle handle. The main body is created via an intersection of a hull of two thin cylinders (with low fn to form the polygon) and two rotated beveling cylinders. The spindle handle is built from a tapered cylinder capped with a sphere at its tip, rotated 180 degrees to extend from the flat base.
